description: Server-side inbox rule CRUD (destructive: covers `delete`; supports `dryRun` on create/update for preview). Rules run on the Exchange server regardless of which client is open. action=`list` (default) returns rules with id/name/sequence — pass `includeDetails: true` to expand conditions/actions/exceptions. action=`create` builds a new rule from condition params (12 supported: fromAddresses, containsSubject, bodyContains, hasAttachments, importance, sentTo, sensitivity, etc.), action params (9 supported: moveToFolder, forwardTo, redirectTo, assignCategories, markAsRead, delete, etc.), and optional `except*` exceptions. action=`update` patches the named fields by `ruleId`. action=`reorder` changes execution priority via `sequence` (lower = earlier). action=`delete` removes a rule. Recipient allowlist applies to forwardTo/redirectTo. `permanentDelete` action is intentionally omitted (too dangerous for AI use — use the Outlook UI). Subject to session rate limits (`OUTLOOK_MAX_MANAGE_RULES_PER_SESSION`).

bodyOrSubjectContains.description: Comma-separated keywords matching body OR subject (OR logic) (action=create/update)

containsSubject.description: Comma-separated subject keywords (OR logic). e.g. "invoice, receipt, payment" (action=create/update)

copyToFolder.description: Folder name to copy matching emails to (action=create/update)

deleteMessage.description: Move matching emails to Deleted Items (action=create/update)

exceptSenderContains.description: Comma-separated partial sender matches to exclude (action=create/update)

forwardTo.description: Comma-separated emails to forward matching messages to (action=create/update)

includeDetails.description: Include detailed conditions, actions, and exceptions (action=list)

moveToFolder.description: Folder name to move matching emails to (action=create/update)

name.description: Rule name (action=create required, action=update to rename)

redirectTo.description: Comma-separated emails to redirect matching messages to (action=create/update)

sentCcMe.description: Match emails where I am in CC (action=create/update)

sentOnlyToMe.description: Match emails where I am the only recipient (action=create/update)

sequence.description: Execution order, lower = higher priority (action=create default: auto, action=reorder required)

name: manage-rules
